name: EPIC 217463948
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 7, 13.9 solar radii and 1.04 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 217463948 (K2 campaign 7): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.904167 (16th-84th percentiles 13.216825-14.691095), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,609 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 1.04 solar masses and 13.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,356 K at its surface.
